name: Battle: All-Out
author: Sixth Front
description: Pick ALL-OUT on the main menu: infantry, tanks, helicopters, jets, bombers and ships in one battle, up to 100 soldiers a side (the bots fill in for the players). Two maps about 3 km across: TWIN RIVERS (a navigable river into a lake on the east, a shallow river on the west, farms, villages and a downtown of skyscrapers) and HARBOUR CITY (the sea along the east, a river from an inland lake out to it, a skyscraper city on the coast). Each side has an airbase: a runway where your jets and bombers line up and roll down to take off, an apron with hangars, fuel tanks and a control tower, six helipads where the helicopters stand (they come back 20 seconds after they're lost), and a harbour for your ships.

battle.blurb: Infantry, tanks, air and sea together
battle.tagline: Everything at once. Infantry, tanks, helicopters, jets, bombers and warships, up to 100 a side, on maps three kilometres across.

script: // Infantry, tanks, helicopters, jets, bombers and ships in one battle, on two maps about 3 km across with rivers,
// a lake or the sea, a downtown of skyscrapers and an airbase at each end: a runway (jets and bombers line up at
// its end and roll down it to take off), an apron with hangars and a control tower, eight helipads right beside the
// HQ you spawn at (helicopters stand on them and come back 20 seconds after they're lost) and a harbour on the water. Up to 100 soldiers a side:
// the bots fill whatever the players don't.
const g = api.game, world = g.world, scene = g.scene;
const clamp = (v, a, b) => (v < a ? a : v > b ? b : v);
const rand = (a, b) => a + Math.random() * (b - a);
const own = Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(obj, name), prev = obj[name], fn = make(prev);
undo.push(() => { if (obj[name] === fn) { if (own) obj[name] = prev; else delete obj[name]; } });
onOff(() => { for (const u of undo.splice(0).reverse()) { try { u(); } catch (e) { console.error(e); } } });
// runway / apron / pads: [x, z, length, width] along x; hangars [x, z]; tower [x, z]; harbour [x, z, yaw]
const rw = mirror(L.runway, team), ap = mirror(L.apron, team), pc = mirror(L.pads, team);
// (two rows of four, 40 m apart, starting 50 m from the HQ: a short walk from where you spawn)
team, runway: { x: rw[0], z: rw[1], len: rw[2], wid: rw[3] }, apron: { x: ap[0], z: ap[1], len: ap[2], wid: ap[3] },
padField: { x: pc[0], z: pc[1] }, pads, hangars: L.hangars.map((h) => mirror(h, team)), tower: mirror(L.tower, team),
fuel: L.fuel.map((f) => mirror(f, team)), harbour: { x: hb[0], z: hb[1], yaw: team === 0 ? 0 : Math.PI },
// the ships' harbour (the Naval mod reads it)
if (LAYOUT) { g.__harbours = BASES.map((b) => b.harbour); onOff(() => { delete g.__harbours; }); }
const add = (m) => { scene.add(m); made.push(m); return m; };

onOff(() => { for (const o of made) { if (o.parent) o.parent.remove(o); if (o.geometry) o.geometry.dispose(); if (o.material && o.material.dispose) o.material.dispose(); } for (const b of boxes) if (world.disableBox) world.disableBox(b); });
const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = w; c.height = h;

const speckle = (x, w, h, base, n, a) => { x.fillStyle = base; x.fillRect(0, 0, w, h); for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const v = Math.random(); x.fillStyle = `rgba(${v > 0.5 ? 255 : 0},${v > 0.5 ? 255 : 0},${v > 0.5 ? 255 : 0},${a * Math.random()})`; x.fillRect(Math.random() * w, Math.random() * h, 2, 2); } };
// the runway: dark asphalt, the centre line, the edge lines, the threshold bars and the numbers at both ends
const runwayTex = (len, num) => canvasTex(128, 2048, (x, w, h) => {
x.fillStyle = 'rgba(30,30,30,0.35)'; for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) x.fillRect(w * 0.3 + Math.random() * w * 0.4, Math.random() * h, 6, 60 + Math.random() * 200);
for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) { const bx = 12 + i * 13.5 + (i > 3 ? 4 : 0); if (end) x.fillRect(bx, h - 60, 8, 50); else x.fillRect(bx, 10, 8, 50); }
if (end) { x.translate(w / 2, h - 110); x.fillText(String(num[1]), 0, 0); } else { x.translate(w / 2, 110); x.rotate(Math.PI); x.fillText(String(num[0]), 0, 0); }

const concreteTex = canvasTex(256, 256, (x, w, h) => { speckle(x, w, h, '#8f8c86', 5000, 0.1); x.strokeStyle = 'rgba(40,40,40,0.35)'; x.lineWidth = 2; for (let i = 0; i <= 4; i++) { x.beginPath(); x.moveTo(i * 64, 0); x.lineTo(i * 64, h); x.stroke(); x.beginPath(); x.moveTo(0, i * 64); x.lineTo(w, i * 64); x.stroke(); } }, [1, 1]);
x.strokeStyle = '#e6e2d6'; x.lineWidth = 9; x.beginPath(); x.arc(w / 2, h / 2, w * 0.42, 0, Math.PI * 2); x.stroke();
const flatMat = (map, color = 0xffffff) => keep(new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ map, color, roughness: 0.92, metalness: 0, polygonOffset: true, polygonOffsetFactor: -2, polygonOffsetUnits: -12 }));
const lay = (w, len, x, z, mat, y = 0.07) => {
hangar: std({ color: 0x7c8076, roughness: 0.7, metalness: 0.35, side: THREE.DoubleSide }),
const solid = (x0, y0, z0, x1, y1, z1) => { if (world.addBox) boxes.push(world.addBox(x0, y0, z0, x1, y1, z1, { mat: 'metal' })); };
const ct = concreteTex.clone(); ct.needsUpdate = true; ct.repeat.set(ap.len / 40, ap.wid / 40); keep(ct);
// the taxiway from the apron to the runway's end
lay(18, Math.abs(rw.z - ap.z), rw.x - rw.len / 2 + 60, (rw.z + ap.z) / 2, flatMat(concreteTex, 0x777570), 0.06).rotation.y = Math.PI / 2;
const pct = concreteTex.clone(); pct.needsUpdate = true; pct.repeat.set(4, 2.2); keep(pct);
const m = add(new THREE.Mesh(keep(new THREE.CircleGeometry(10, 32)), padMat));
m.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2; m.position.set(x, ground(x, z) + 0.09, z); m.receiveShadow = true;
// hangars: arched roofs with their doors facing the apron
const y0 = ground(x, z), face = B.team === 0 ? 1 : -1;
const roof = add(new THREE.Mesh(keep(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(15, 15, 34, 20, 1, true, -Math.PI / 2, Math.PI)), M.hangar));
roof.rotation.z = Math.PI / 2; roof.rotation.y = Math.PI / 2; roof.position.set(x, y0, z); roof.castShadow = true; roof.receiveShadow = true;
const back = add(new THREE.Mesh(keep(new THREE.CircleGeometry(15, 20, 0, Math.PI)), M.hangar));
back.position.set(x, y0, z - face * 17); if (face < 0) back.rotation.y = Math.PI;
const door = add(new THREE.Mesh(keep(new THREE.CircleGeometry(14.6, 20, 0, Math.PI)), M.dark));
door.position.set(x, y0, z + face * 16.9); if (face > 0) door.rotation.y = Math.PI;
const [x, z] = B.tower, y0 = ground(x, z);
const shaft = add(new THREE.Mesh(keep(new THREE.BoxGeometry(6, 18, 6)), M.wall)); shaft.position.set(x, y0 + 9, z); shaft.castShadow = true;
const cab = add(new THREE.Mesh(keep(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(5.5, 4.6, 4, 8)), M.glass)); cab.position.set(x, y0 + 20, z);
const lid = add(new THREE.Mesh(keep(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(6.2, 6.2, 0.6, 8)), M.dark)); lid.position.set(x, y0 + 22.3, z);
const mast = add(new THREE.Mesh(keep(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.15, 0.15, 6, 6)), M.red)); mast.position.set(x, y0 + 25.6, z);
const t = add(new THREE.Mesh(keep(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(7, 7, 9, 24)), M.tank)); t.position.set(x, y0 + 4.5, z); t.castShadow = true;
// the harbour: a pier out into the water
const pier = add(new THREE.Mesh(keep(new THREE.BoxGeometry(70, 1.2, 8)), M.pier));
if (LAYOUT) for (const B of BASES) buildBase(B);
// helicopters on a free helipad (and home to it), jets and bombers lined up at the end of the runway
const T = a.type, hb = T.hit && T.hit[0];
const big = a.kind === 'bomber', L = clamp(T.radius * (big ? 0.1 : 0.13), 0.75, big ? 2.4 : 1.6);
const busy = (x, z) => A.fleet.some((o) => o !== a && o.exists && Math.hypot(o.pos.x - x, o.pos.z - z) < 14);
const [x, z] = free.length ? free[Math.floor(Math.random() * free.length)] : B.pads[Math.floor(Math.random() * B.pads.length)];
return { x, z, yaw: B.team === 0 ? 0 : Math.PI, alt: a.type.rest || 1.25 };
// jets and bombers: the end of the runway, nose down it toward the other end
const rw = B.runway, dir = B.team === 0 ? 1 : -1, side = (rollSide = -rollSide) * 9;
const x = rw.x - dir * (rw.len / 2 - 40), z = rw.z + side;
a.takeoff = { t: 0, v: 0, s: 0, x0: x, z0: z, dx: dir, dz: 0, gear: gh, vr: Math.max(a.type.flight.stall * 1.45, 50), acc: a.kind === 'bomber' ? 7 : 11, lift: 0 };
return { x, z, yaw: yawOf(dir, 0), y: ground(x, z) + gh, speed: 0 };
// the takeoff roll: full power down the runway, wheels down, the nose lifts at flying speed and it climbs away;
// then the pilot (or the bot) has it
const ZUP = new V3(0, 1, 0), _e = new THREE.Euler();
let x = R.x0 + R.dx * R.s, z = R.z0 + R.dz * R.s, pitch = 0;
if (R.v >= R.vr) { R.lift += dt; pitch = Math.min(0.2, R.lift * 0.14); }
const y = ground(x, z) + R.gear + R.lift * R.lift * 3.2;
a.yaw = yaw; a.pitch = pitch; a.roll = 0; a.hYaw = yaw;
a.vel.set(R.dx * R.v, R.lift > 0 ? R.lift * 6.4 : 0, R.dz * R.v);
if (!a.gearDown) { a.gearDown = true; if (AIR0().gear) AIR0().gear(a, true); }
// airborne and climbing: hand over, gear up
onOff(() => { if (A.launchSpot === launchSpot) { if (prevSpot) A.launchSpot = prevSpot; else delete A.launchSpot; } });
if (this.takeoff && this.exists && this.state === 'flying') return rollUpdate(this, dt);
// helicopters come back 20 seconds after they're lost; more of everything in the air
for (const t of A.types) if (t.kind === 'heli') { const r = t.respawn; t.respawn = 20; onOff(() => { t.respawn = r; }); }
const keepMax = { heli: A.maxHeli, bots: A.maxBots };
// a second transport and a second of each attack helicopter a side
for (const t of A.types) if (t.kind === 'heli') for (const team of t.teams) {
if (A.fleet.filter((o) => o.type === t && o.team === team && !o.reserved).length < 2) A.addAircraft(t, team);
// your own jets and bombers (the ones you've bought) on the deploy screen, from the runway
const owns = (t, team) => { const C = g.__career; if (!C) return true; return !!((C.deployable && C.deployable('air', t.id, team)) || (C.owned && C.owned('air', t.id, team))); };
// (online every page has to build the same aircraft in the same order, so there it's one of every type for both
// sides; offline only the ones you've bought, when they're first needed)
const online = () => { const MP = g.__mp; return !!(MP && ((MP.live && MP.live()) || (MP.role && MP.role()))); };
if (!A.fleet.some((o) => o.type === t && o.team === tm && o.reserved)) { const a = A.addAircraft(t, tm); a.reserved = true; }
// In deep water a soldier swims at the surface instead of walking along the bottom (slowly)
// SOLDIERS PER SIDE on the main menu while ALL-OUT is picked: up to 100 (fewer on a phone or tablet by default)
try { return prev.apply(this, args); } finally { st.botsPerTeam = keepN; }
// (in place of the usual 8–20 choice, which stays for the other battles)

row.innerHTML = 'SOLDIERS PER SIDE<select id="ao-bots"><option value="25">25 v 25</option><option value="50">50 v 50</option><option value="75">75 v 75</option><option value="100">100 v 100</option></select>';
sel.addEventListener('change', () => { g.settings.allOutBots = Number(sel.value); try { localStorage.setItem('sixthfront.settings', JSON.stringify(g.settings)); } catch (e) { /* no storage */ } });
const usual = document.getElementById('set-bots'), usualRow = usual && usual.closest('label');
if (usualRow) { usualRow.after(row); usualRow.style.display = 'none'; onOff(() => { row.remove(); usualRow.style.display = ''; }); }
else { const box = document.querySelector('#menu-main .settings'); if (box) { box.appendChild(row); onOff(() => row.remove()); } }
// The jets and bombers you've bought stand on the apron in front of the hangars, wheels down. Walk up to one and get
// in ([E], GET IN on a phone): the view moves into the cockpit as it lines up at the end of the runway and rolls.
const apronSlots = (B) => { const ap = B.apron, out = []; for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) out.push([ap.x - ap.len / 2 + 50 + i * 48, ap.z + (B.team === 0 ? -8 : 8)]); return out; };
const parkFor = (team) => { const A = AIR0(); return A ? A.fleet.filter((a) => a.team === team && a.reserved && (a.kind === 'jet' || a.kind === 'bomber') && owns(a.type, team)) : []; };
if (!a.gearDown) { a.gearDown = true; if (AIR0().gear) AIR0().gear(a, true); }
const slots = apronSlots(B), face = B.team === 0 ? Math.PI : 0;
if (here) { const [x, z] = slots[i++ % slots.length]; if (!parked.has(a)) park(a, x, z, face); }
// planes that left: their parking places are free again (and a parked one no longer yours is put away)
for (const a of [...parked]) if (a.exists || a.state !== 'ready' || a.team !== P.team) { parked.delete(a); if (!a.exists) a.hull.visible = false; }
// you, on foot beside one: get in
for (const a of parked) { const d = Math.hypot(a.pos.x - P.pos.x, a.pos.z - P.pos.z); if (d < bd) { bd = d; best = a; } }
if (!best) { if (ctl.context && ctl.context.kind === 'getin') { ctl.context = null; g.hud.setPrompt(null); } return; }
onOff(() => { for (const a of parked) if (!a.exists) a.hull.visible = false; parked.clear(); });
